t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are six gnomes that correspond to basket color. The best strategy is to pick one color basket and the associated gnomes until the number goes too low, then select the other color gnome.

vb_textbox.text: There are 8 gnomes each associated with one of two colored baskets--red or yellow. The red, purple, brown, and pink gnomes are associated with the red basket. The yellow, blue, orange, and green gnomes are associated with the yellow basket.Pick one color basket and select the gnomes for it until you receive 0 mushrooms. Then switch to the other color basket.
